ei.title: Roger Payne: A Pioneer in Whale Conservation
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Roger Payne was born in Manhattan in 1935. He studied biology at Harvard University and eventually earned his Ph.D. from Cornell University in 1961. In 1967, he discovered that humpback whales make long and complex sounds. They're known as "whale songs," and he showed that whales use them to communicate. Then in 1970, he released an album Songs of the Humpback Whale, which became a surprise hit and helped start the global "Save the Whales" movement. The following year, he founded Ocean Alliance to protect whales and the earth's oceans, and he used new, safe methods to study whales without harming them. Over his career, he led more than 100 research trips worldwide, including the Voyage of the Odyssey from 2000 to 2005, which studied ocean pollution. His work helped make laws that protect marine mammals, which finally led to the global ban on commercial whaling in 1986.

det.korean: 전치사 without 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 온다: harm → harming
det.analysis: 전치사 without 뒤에는 명사 역할의 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 한다. 'without harming them' = 그것들을 해치지 않고. harm(동사원형) → harming(동명사)
det.tip: without + V-ing(동명사): without harming = 해치지 않고

questions.passage: Over his career, he led more than 100 research trips worldwide, including the Voyage of the Odyssey from 2000 to 2005, which studied ocean pollution. His work helped make laws that protect marine mammals, which finally led to the global ban on commercial __________ (whale) in 1986.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'commercial __________ (whale)'에서 '상업적 고래잡이'라는 명사가 필요. 동사 whale(고래를 잡다)에서 파생된 동명사/명사 whaling(고래잡이)이 적절. the ban on commercial whaling = 상업적 고래잡이에 대한 금지
det.tip: whale(v. 고래잡이하다) → whaling(n. 고래잡이). ban on whaling = 고래잡이 금지

questions.passage: Roger Payne was born in Manhattan in 1935. He studied biology at Harvard University and eventually earned his Ph.D. from Cornell University in 1961. In 1967, he discovered that humpback whales make long and complex sounds. They're known as "whale songs," and he showed that whales use them to communicate. Then in 1970, he released an album Songs of the Humpback Whale, which became a surprise hit and __________ the global "Save the Whales" movement. The following year, he founded Ocean Alliance to protect whales and the earth's oceans, and he used new, safe methods to study whales without harming them. Over his career, he led more than 100 research trips worldwide, including the Voyage of the Odyssey from 2000 to 2005, which studied ocean pollution. His work helped make laws that protect marine mammals, which finally led to the global ban on commercial whaling in 1986.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: helped start=시작하는 것을 도왔다 — 앨범이 전 세계적 운동을 시작하는 데 기여
det.analysis:
✅ ① helped start: 앨범이 '뜻밖의 인기(surprise hit)'를 얻어 전 세계적 'Save the Whales' 운동을 '시작하는 것을 도왔다(helped start)'는 맥락에 적절 ←정답
❌ ② put an end to: '~을 끝냈다'는 운동을 시작했다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ stayed away from: '멀리했다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ had nothing to do with: '~와 무관했다'는 맥락과 반대

questions.passage: Roger Payne was born in Manhattan in 1935. He studied biology at Harvard University and eventually earned his Ph.D. from Cornell University in 1961. In 1967, he discovered that humpback whales make long and complex sounds. They're known as "whale songs," and he showed that whales use them to communicate. Then in 1970, he released an album Songs of the Humpback Whale, which became a surprise hit and helped start the global "Save the Whales" movement. The following year, he founded Ocean Alliance to protect whales and the earth's oceans, and he used new, safe methods to study whales without harming them. Over his career, he led more than 100 research trips worldwide, including the Voyage of the Odyssey from 2000 to 2005, which studied ocean pollution. His work __________ laws that protect marine mammals, which finally led to the global ban on commercial whaling in 1986.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: helped make=만드는 데 기여했다 — 그의 연구가 해양 포유류 보호법을 만드는 데 기여
det.analysis:
✅ ② helped make: 그의 연구가 해양 포유류를 보호하는 법을 '만드는 데 기여했다(helped make)'는 맥락에 적절. 뒤에 '마침내 세계적 금지를 이끌었다'와 연결 ←정답
❌ ① did away with: '없앴다'는 법을 만들었다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ objected to: '반대했다'는 보호법 제정에 기여한 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ ignored: '무시했다'는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: help make laws = 법을 만드는 데 기여하다
